logic.entry: On closed UTC daily candle j, close[j] > max(high[j-E:j]) with the comparison channel excluding the current signal day.
logic.exit: Seed Wilder ATR from the first N true ranges by arithmetic mean; update recursively ATR=((N-1)*prior_ATR+TR)/N. At entry freeze ATR_entry and peak_close=signal close. On later closed bars ratchet peak_close=max(peak_close,close); stop=max(previous_stop,peak_close-M*ATR_entry). Exit if close <= stop, next-day 00:01 minute-open reference. Stop is close-confirmed; no intraday stop fills.
logic.sizing: Independent 2,000 USDT single-asset long-only spot account; no leverage, short, add-on, interest or transfer.
logic.timing: Only complete daily bars; signal executes at next daily 00:01 one-minute open. OOS starts flat; terminal liquidation at fixed OOS end.

parameters.impact_model: 0.5 * sample_stdev(previous 20 complete UTC daily log returns) * sqrt(order quote budget / previous 20 complete daily quote-volume ADV)

sources.citation: TA-Lib official ATR source (Wilder smoothing and true-range definition).
sources.implementation: TR=max(H-L,abs(H-prev_close),abs(L-prev_close)); ATR seed is the simple mean of the first n complete TR values; subsequent ATR=((n-1)*prior_ATR+TR)/n. Own transparent implementation is audited against these published steps.
